description.7.0: Assigns a property to elements in the range. The element can have isotropic, orthotropic, or anisotropic elastic material properties. Note that if the liner is embedded, then coupling spring properties must be entered separately on side 2. The following properties are available:
description.9.0: Assign properties to liner elements in the range. Properties include density, thickness, thermal-expansion, anisotropic-membrane, anisotropic-bending, material, isotropic, orthotropic-membrane, orthotropic-bending, slide, slide-tolerance, coupling-yield, coupling-yield-normal-2, coupling-stiffness, coupling-cohesion-shear, coupling-friction-shear, coupling-friction-shear-2, effective. The properties consist of constitutive model properties, shell-type properties, and coupling-spring properties. The constitutive model property names are primary keywords, but are not included in the list above. The following properties are available, with the constitutive model properties listed first.

description.7.0: density (needed if dynamic mode or gravity is active)

keywords.name: anisotropic-membrane
keywords.description: anisotropic membrane material properties {\(c^{\prime}_{11}, c^{\prime}_{12}, c^{\prime}_{13}, c^{\prime}_{22}, c^{\prime}_{23}, c^{\prime}_{33}\)} \([F/L^2]\), which define membrane material-stiffness matrices \([Eʹ_m]\) and \([Eʹ_b]\), respectively, in the material directions \(x'\), \(y'\), \(z'\)

keywords.name: anisotropic-bending
keywords.description: anisotropic bending material properties {\(c^{\prime}_{11}, c^{\prime}_{12}, c^{\prime}_{13}, c^{\prime}_{22}, c^{\prime}_{23}, c^{\prime}_{33}\)} \([F/L^2]\), which define bending material-stiffness matrices \([Eʹ_m]\) and \([Eʹ_b]\), respectively, in the material directions \(x'\), \(y'\), \(z'\).

keywords.name: material-x
keywords.description: specify the vector v whose projection onto the geogrid surface defines the \(xʹ\)-axis of the material coordinate system. The material directions correspond with the principal directions of orthotropy (for more information, see below).

keywords.name: isotropic
keywords.description: isotropic material properties: \(E\) and \(v\) where \(E\) is Young’s modulus \([F/L^2]\) and \(v\) is Poisson’s ratio

keywords.name: orthotropic-membrane
keywords.description: orthotropic membrane material properties {\(c^{\prime}_{11}, c^{\prime}_{12}, c^{\prime}_{22}, c^{\prime}_{33}\)} \([F/L^2]\), which define membrane material-stiffness matrices \([Eʹ_m]\) and \([Eʹ_b]\), respectively, in the material directions \(x\)‘, \(y\)‘, \(z\)‘.

keywords.name: orthotropic-bending
keywords.description: orthotropic bending material properties {\(c^{\prime}_{11}, c^{\prime}_{12}, c^{\prime}_{22}, c^{\prime}_{33}\)} \([F/L^2]\), which define bending material-stiffness matrices \([Eʹ_m]\) and \([Eʹ_b]\), respectively, in the material directions \(x\)‘, \(y\)‘, \(z\)‘.

keywords.name: coupling-yield-normal
keywords.description: normal coupling spring tensile strength (stress units)

description.7.0: normal coupling spring tensile strength on side 2 (stress units)
description.9.0: normal coupling spring tensile strength (stress units) on side 2

description.7.0: normal coupling spring stiffness per unit area
description.9.0: coupling spring normal stiffness per unit area

description.7.0: normal coupling spring stiffness per unit area on side 2
description.9.0: coupling spring normal stiffness per unit area on side 2

description.7.0: shear coupling spring stiffness per unit area
description.9.0: coupling spring shear stiffness per unit area

description.7.0: shear coupling spring stiffness per unit area on side 2
description.9.0: coupling spring shear stiffness per unit area on side 2

description.7.0: shear coupling spring cohesion (stress unit) on side 2
description.9.0: shear coupling spring cohesion (stress units) on side 2
shear coupling spring residual cohesion (stress units)

description.7.0: shear coupling spring residual cohesion on side 2
description.9.0: shear coupling spring residual cohesion (stress units) on side 2

keywords.name: coupling-friction-shear-2
keywords.description: shear coupling spring friction angle (degrees) on side 2

description.7.0: effective stress flag (default to on). If off, then pore-pressures are not removed from the stress normal to the liner when determining shear failure limits.
